name: omnigami-question-film
description: Tall app ad for a product that answers requests: your users' questions fill the screen in your own input style, each folding up as your product's real answer rises under it, closing on your input and lockup. 30 seconds, 9:16, with music; an independent style study of Spotify's "Now you can talk to Spotify" ad. Use for a vertical app ad, a Reel, TikTok or Shorts ad for an assistant, search, chat or booking product, or a "talk to it" film.
